title: ops-attachment-concierge-with-kv-span-filtering-and-autolink
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an 'attachment concierge' microservice that assembles compact, prioritized evidence bundles for PagerDuty incidents and Slack incident threads. The concierge will: (1) attach a ranked digest of top spans and KV cache hits for the alert window, (2) auto-link relevant runbook sections and playbook anchors, (3) apply size and PII redaction heuristics, and (4) provide deterministic signatures so downstream UIs can cache and dedupe attachments. Goal is to reduce mean time to acknowledgement (MTTA) for SLO-affecting incidents by surfacing actionable context rather than full traces.
acceptance_criteria: PD webhook payloads contain an attachments[0].evidence_bundle with top 5 ranked spans and top 10 relevant KV keys
Slack incident thread posts include a summarized attachment card with runbook links and a 'Jump to trace' URL that opens the trace viewer at the highlighted span
Attachment size capped at 256KB; service returns a 'truncated' flag when exceeded
PII redaction rules applied: email, api_key, access_token redacted using configured policies
End-to-end tests covering PD retry, Slack rate limits, and attachment dedupe signature
decisions: Use a separate lightweight Go service (concierge) rather than adding to alert-router so we can scale independently
Ranking heuristic will be hybrid: priority_score = 0.6 * error_rate_z + 0.3 * latency_regression_score + 0.1 * user_impact_weight
Store dedupe signatures in Redis with 24h TTL; do not persist raw traces in the concierge
Runbook autolink resolution will use a static index in S3 updated by CI to avoid runtime dependency on Confluence API
implementation_notes: Input: alert window traces (slice from tracing service), metric anomaly context (from metrics pipeline), and recent logs (tail sample)
KV/span filtering: prefer spans with error tags, high latency percentiles, or direct ties to impacted routes (route label present)
PII redaction will rely on regex rules from security team and a small allowlist for developer debug keys
Expose a /v1/synthesize endpoint that returns JSON evidence_bundle and a compact text summary for Slack attachments
Backpressure strategy: if traces unavailable or service overloaded return a lightweight 'context-only' bundle with metrics summary
Rate limits: PD attachments max 2/sec per team to avoid PD throttling; implement burst token bucket
Telemetry: emit metrics for bundle_size_bytes, synthesis_duration_ms, redaction_counts, dedupe_hit_rate
qa_steps: Deploy to staging, trigger synthetic latency spike for /v1/generate with tracing enabled
Verify PD incident shows evidence_bundle with top spans and runbook links; click 'Jump to trace' opens trace viewer at span
Simulate PII-containing logs and confirm redaction pattern coverage
Measure MTTA on a set of historical incidents with concierge on vs off (A/B) in staging dashboards
Run fuzz test sending oversized traces and confirm 'truncated' flag and graceful fallback
